snippet.title: Interstellar Nomad Guide 1: Controls Explained – Beginner's Tutorial
snippet.description: In this video, I’ll explain how the controls work in this space exploration game. Some of the controls in Interstellar Nomad are different from what you might be used to in other games, so this guide will help you get started and avoid confusion.
